claim.claim-text: 1. A pegylated type I interferon for use in the treatment of a myeloproliferative disease in a subject, wherein the pegylated type I interferon is

wherein mPEG has a molecular weight of 20 kD and IFN is an interferon-α<2b>, and wherein a 50 to 540 µg dose of the pegylated type I interferon is administered to a subject in need thereof at a regular interval of every 4 weeks for a treatment period, wherein the myeloproliferative disease is polycythemia vera.
2. The pegylated type I interferon for use according to claim 1 wherein the treatment period is at least 2 to 12 months.
3. The pegylated type I interferon for use according to claim 1, wherein the treatment period is at least 12 months.
4. The pegylated type I interferon for use according to any of claims 1 to 3, wherein a constant dose of the pegylated type I interferon is administered.
5. The pegylated type I interferon for use according to any of claims 1 to 4, wherein the pegylated type I interferon is administered subcutaneously.

6. The pegylated type I interferon for use according to any of claims 1 to 5, wherein the subject had previously been administered the type I interferon once every 2 weeks for at least 2 to 12 months.

7. The pegylated type I interferon for use according to any of claims 1 to 6, wherein a 50 to 540 µg dose of the pegylated type I interferon was previously administered to a subject in need thereof at a first regular interval for a first treatment period, the first interval being every 2 weeks, and subsequently a 50 to 540 µg dose of the pegylated type I interferon is administered to the subject at a second regular interval for a second treatment period, the second interval being every 4 weeks, wherein said second treatment period is the treatment period according to claim 1.

8. The pegylated type I interferon for use according to claim 7, wherein the total amount of the pegylated type I interferon administered to the subject per a given period during the second treatment period is lower than the total amount administered per the given period during the first treatment period.

9. The pegylated type I interferon for use according to claim 7, wherein the first treatment period continues until the subject exhibits (i) normalization of at least one hematological parameter and/or (ii) at least 50% reduction of JAK2V617F allelic burden, specifically the at least one hematological parameter is hematocrit, white blood cell count (WBC), or platelet count.

10. The pegylated type I interferon for use according to claim 9, wherein the hematocrit is less than 45%, the WBC is less than or equal to 10 x 10<9>/L, and the platelet count is less than or equal to 400 x 10<9>/L.

11. The pegylated type I interferon for use according to any of claims 7 to 10, wherein the second treatment period is at least 2 to 12 months and/or the first treatment period is at least 2 to 12 months.

12. The pegylated type I interferon for use of any of claims 7 to 11, wherein a constant dose of the pegylated type I interferon is administered during the first and/or second treatment period, specifically the same constant dose is administered during the first treatment period and the second treatment period, or the constant dose administered during the second treatment period is lower than the constant dose administered during the first treatment period.
